app.name: Domain Checker by AgentCom
app.subtitle: Check domain availability
app.description: Checks exact domain availability and compares available domain options for naming workflows.
capabilities: Support naming workflows with verified availability
starter_prompts: Check whether example.ai is free to register.
Verify the domains I am considering are available.

tools.name: check_domain_availability
tools.description: Check whether an exact domain name is currently available to register. Use when the user asks whether a specific domain is available; do not use for general naming advice without an availability request.

annotation_justifications.readOnlyHint: True because this tool only reads current domain registration status and does not mutate user or external state.
annotation_justifications.openWorldHint: True because this tool queries live public domain-registration infrastructure outside ChatGPT.
annotation_justifications.destructiveHint: False because availability checks do not delete, overwrite, cancel, charge, or irreversibly modify anything.
annotation_justifications.idempotentHint: True because repeating the same availability lookup has no additional side effect.

positive.prompt: Can you check whether example.ai is free to register?
I want exact current availability for foo.dev.
Before I name this company, verify bar.co is available.
Look up the registration status of test.org.

negative.prompt: Brainstorm names for a pet comedy show.
